answer_2.quote: The sentences in a minimal pair are ranked based on their perplexity (PPL) or pseudoperplexity (PPPL).

answer_4.quote: We establish the human baseline on 5% of RuBLiMP (2,350 pairs; 50 pairs per paradigm) using ABC, a crowdsourcing platform. Each of the 144 hired workers is certified as a native Russian speaker and paid $15/hr on average. The annotation task is to select a grammatical sentence in a given pair
